data.one_liner: Lightweight Dart package for internationalizing and converting units of measurement.
data.what_it_does: It converts between a vast range of measurement units like length, mass, temperature, and numeral systems. It also allows developers to define custom simple or complex linear/non-linear conversions.
use_when: You need to convert units of measurement in a Flutter or Dart app.
You want to internationalize measurement units with custom formatting and decimal separators.
avoid_when: You require real-time currency conversion rates fetched from an online API (this package only handles static mapping).
strengths: Supports a wide array of built-in unit categories
Supports custom conversions and numeral systems
weaknesses: Does not automatically fetch live exchange rates or external data
